use default

extend(prefix: LIST[int], size: int) -> Pipe[List[int]] is
    if prefix.count == size then
        yield prefix |> collect()
    else
        for candidate in 0..size do
            if candidate != prefix.count /\
                !(prefix |> any(taken => taken == candidate)) then
                prefix.add(candidate)

                yield in extend(prefix, size)

                prefix.remove_at(prefix.count - 1)
            fi
        od
    fi
si

derangements(size: int) -> Pipe[List[int]] => extend(LIST[int](), size)

subfactorials() -> Pipe[bigint] is
    let previous mut = 1n
    let current mut = 0n
    let index mut = 0

    do
        yield previous

        let following = bigint(index + 1) * (current + previous)

        previous = current
        current = following
        index = index + 1
    od
si

write_line("the derangements of four items:")

derangements(4)
    |> each(one => write_line("  {one |> join(" ")}"))

write_line()
write_line(" n   counted   subfactorial")

(0::9)
    |> zip(subfactorials())
    |> each((size, calculated) =>
        write_line("{size,2}{derangements(size) |> count(),10}"
                   "{calculated,15}"))

write_line()
write_line("!20 = {subfactorials() |> skip(20) |> first_or_throw():N0}")
